meta.title: Theme Gate Probe
meta._note: The DECK is clean; the THEME is the defect. meta.theme resolves to evals/golden/themes/bad-contrast.json — a deliberately broken theme kept out of themes/ so it can never be offered to a user. Covers the two theme-dependent Tier-1 checks the deck fixtures cannot reach: contrast (text/muted below 4.5:1, accent below 3:1, a series pair under 60 RGB distance, a series under 3:1 on surface, and one non-hex colour) and min-type-size (body 15pt). Cards are deliberately light so overflow stays silent.
